title: Observability: fips_aggregate NOT_OPERATIONAL emits no log identifying failing provider
description: crypto2dev_fips_aggregate() in src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c lines 281-314: when p->algos[i]->fips_gate() returns non-zero, the function immediately returns CRYPTO2DEV_FIPS_NOT_OPERATIONAL with no kernel log. There is no message identifying which provider's gate failed, what wolfCrypt status was returned, or which algorithm triggered the check. A support engineer polling IOC_STATUS and seeing fips_state==2 cannot determine the cause from dmesg without a debugger. Fix: at the point crypto2dev_fips_aggregate() detects a failing gate, emit pr_err_ratelimited naming the provider (p->name) and the return code.
